# Target launch descriptors (generated by the controller; listed here for audit)

Every container is started by `cutwitness/realtargets.py::launch_slot` with `docker run -d` and:
`--cpuset-cpus <slot cpuset> --memory 32g --memory-swap 32g --pids-limit 8192 --ulimit nofile=65536:65536`,
a per-slot scratch volume, a loopback-only port `127.0.0.1:<port_base + 10*slot + target_index>`, and labels
`cutwitness.run=<run_id>`, `cutwitness.target=<target>`, `cutwitness.slot=<slot>`.

| Target | Image (pinned) | Command | Readiness probe |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| pg_ivm | `cutwitness/pg_ivm:frozen` built from `server/targets/pgivm/Dockerfile` | `postgres -c shared_preload_libraries=pg_ivm -c max_connections=200` | SQL `SELECT 1`, then `server_version_num == 170010` and pg_ivm `1.16` |
| risingwave | `risingwavelabs/risingwave:v3.1.0` (digest journaled) | `single_node` | SQL `SELECT version()` contains `RisingWave-3.1.0` |
| feldera | `ghcr.io/feldera/pipeline-manager:0.366.0` (digest journaled) | image default | `GET /v0/config` version `0.366.0` |

Cleanup: labelled containers are removed at start (orphans from a crashed controller), on normal exit, and before relaunch on resume.
The PostgreSQL password `cw` is a fixed, non-secret credential for a loopback-only test container.
